clandetail.faq.questions.0.answer: A Clan is the heart of Mezon — where people connect, collaborate, and share through communities built around shared interests, goals, or passions. A Clan can be a small group of friends or a large-scale community with thousands of members. Within a Clan, you can chat through organized Channels, host events via Voice Channels, and enhance your community using Bots, Apps, and Mezon Tokens.
clandetail.faq.questions.0.question: What Is A Clan On Mezon?
clandetail.faq.questions.1.answer: You can discover and join Clans in two ways: through the Discover button within the app or via the Clans Website at mezon.ai/clans, or by using an invite link shared by friends, teammates, or admins. Simply click "Join" to become part of the community. Each user can join up to 50 Clans at once. Explore featured Clans like Student Clan, Gamer Clan, and Business Clan.
clandetail.faq.questions.1.question: How Do I Join A Clan On Mezon?
clandetail.faq.questions.2.answer: Creating a Clan is simple and highly flexible. Navigate to the Clans section and create a new Clan with just a few clicks. You can set a name, icon, and basic settings to customize your community. Once created, you can invite friends and teammates to start conversations, share ideas, or collaborate together. You can also manage channels, set permissions, and transfer ownership if needed.
clandetail.faq.questions.2.question: How Do I Create My Own Clan?
clandetail.faq.questions.3.answer: Yes. If you no longer wish to be part of a Clan, you can select 'Leave Clan' from the Clan's settings. Once you leave, all message history and access to that Clan's channels will be removed from your account. You can always rejoin the Clan later if you have an invite link or if the Clan is publicly discoverable.

mezondong.faq.questions.0.answer: Mezon Dong is a digital unit of value used as an internal exchange tool within the Mezon platform. It is a built-in digital payment system that helps you send and transfer money easily, transparently, and securely.
mezondong.faq.questions.0.question: What is Mezon Dong?
mezondong.faq.questions.1.answer: Mezon Dong is not just for spending but also for sharing. You can send tokens to friends, colleagues, or Clan members in just a few simple steps. Sending Mezon Dong is as easy as sending a message - open a conversation, tap the Mezon Dong icon, enter the amount, and confirm. Transactions are processed instantly and with no fees.
mezondong.faq.questions.1.question: How do I send and transfer Mezon Dong?
mezondong.faq.questions.2.answer: Businesses can use Mezon as an internal platform for communication and payments. You can reward employees, manage benefits, or create internal incentive programs. Everything is handled smoothly and flexibly with Mezon Dong.
mezondong.faq.questions.2.question: How can businesses use Mezon Dong?
mezondong.faq.questions.3.answer: Partner brands can accept Mezon Dong for their products and services. From digital goods to physical items , the community can shop directly with just one click. Contact the Mezon team to set up a merchant account and integrate Mezon Dong into your store.

textchannel.faq.questions.0.answer: To add friends on Mezon, go to the Friends page and enter a Mezon username in the 'Add Friend' section. You can manage your friend list with filters such as All, Online, Pending (friend requests), and Block (blocked users). You can also see your friends' online status in real time and view what they're doing through the Activity section, which shows if they're coding, listening to music, or gaming.
textchannel.faq.questions.0.question: How Do I Add Friends On Mezon?
textchannel.faq.questions.1.answer: Mezon offers comprehensive messaging features including sending text, emojis, stickers, images, videos, files, and voice recordings; pinning important messages for quick access; creating small group chats with up to 10 members; making 1-on-1 or group voice and video calls  in HD quality; screen sharing during calls; and searching messages. All communication features are completely free, with no limits.
textchannel.faq.questions.1.question: What Messaging Features Does Mezon Offer?
textchannel.faq.questions.2.answer: Mezon allows you to make 1-on-1 or  small‑group voice and video calls directly within the app. During calls, you can turn your microphone or camera on/off anytime, share your screen, and enjoy stable connections with HD video and low-latency voice. When someone calls you, your phone or computer will ring just like a regular call. All calls are free run over your internet connection.
textchannel.faq.questions.2.question: How Do Voice And Video Calls Work On Mezon?
textchannel.faq.questions.3.answer: Yes, Mezon prioritizes privacy and security. You can only message people who are your friends or share at least one Clan with you, preventing spam and ensuring a private space. Messages are synchronized across Web, Desktop, and Mobile platforms in real-time, so you never miss anything. When your group becomes more active, you can upgrade it into a Clan to unlock additional features like multiple channels and admin permissions.
textchannel.faq.questions.3.question: Is My Communication On Mezon Private And Secure?
textchannel.faq.title: Need More Help?
textchannel.sections.section1.descriptio: Mezon is great for friends to hang out and spend time together, whether taking an afternoon break or staying late into the night.
textchannel.sections.section1.title: Chill With Friends, Hang Out In Voice Channels
textchannel.sections.section2.descriptio: You can effortlessly connect with friends by opening a voice channel – and it's free forever. The more you use Mezon, the more you'll realize how easy it is to keep in touch all day long.
textchannel.sections.section2.title: Connect Easily, Chat Smoothly With Voice Channels
textchannel.sections.section3.descriptio: Catch up on announcements and livestreams as quickly as possible. Join a livestream at any time or react to important news from the channel or team.
textchannel.sections.section3.title: Stream And Announcements For Everyone To Follow
textchannel.sections.section4.descriptio: Channel Apps help you stay up to date with everything – from notifications, notes, calendars to todo list management. Mezon provides a unique App system with a wide range of choices for every lifestyle.
textchannel.sections.section4.title: Channel Apps That Make Your Life Easier
textchannel.sections.section5.descriptio: Bots help you complete tasks quickly and efficiently, from managing schedules to providing instant responses. Mezon Bots are built to serve the entire clan, making work easier and more organized.
